briefing.summary: Brisbane Centre is handing you off to Sydney Centre.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, contact Sydney Centre one three four decimal eight five.

challenge.expectedText: Sydney Centre one three four decimal eight five, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Frequency
accept: one three four decimal eight five
elements.hint: Read back the full frequency including 'decimal' — not 'point' and not just the digits.

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: frequency changes are a mandatory readback item. Read back the station + full frequency + callsign. 'Roger' alone is not a frequency readback.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Mandatory readback items — frequency changes.
